about.label: About
about.title: Where engineering meets user experience.
about.p1: I'm a Frontend Developer focused on building modern, scalable, and user-centered web applications. I primarily work with React, Next.js, and Angular, with an emphasis on component architecture, maintainable code, and performance optimization. I also have experience working with Vue.js.
about.p2: I enjoy solving complex frontend challenges, collaborating with development teams, and turning ideas into reliable digital products. My experience includes working on enterprise applications, data-driven interfaces, and geospatial platforms, which has helped me develop a deeper understanding of frontend engineering. I'm continuously improving my engineering skills and looking for opportunities to collaborate with professional teams and contribute to meaningful products.

items.desc: Working independently on frontend development projects, focusing on responsive user interfaces, practical product features, and improved user experiences. I aim to deliver structured, maintainable code and choose technical solutions that align with each product's requirements. I'm also open to joining professional teams and contributing to the development of web products.

Contributed to the frontend development of enterprise and GIS-based applications using Angular and Next.js. Worked with complex data-driven interfaces, reusable components, dynamic form generation, and geospatial technologies. This experience strengthened my understanding of frontend architecture and the development of enterprise-scale software products.

Contributed to the implementation and development of user interfaces for websites and web applications. This role provided practical experience in a professional software development environment, working with React and Next.js, and translating designs and requirements into functional user interfaces.

items.desc: A nationwide platform for discovering and sharing tours and events. Contributed to its frontend development, focusing on dynamic content presentation, page structure, and seamless user interactions.

items.name: GeoTajak
items.desc: An enterprise WebGIS platform for managing, editing, and integrating geospatial data. Contributed to frontend development, including geospatial layer management, dynamic form generation, and data-driven interfaces using Angular and GIS technologies.

items.desc: My first website project, developed for Montazer Ghaem Technical School. The website introduces educational programs, school facilities, faculty members, and student achievements, while providing a platform for school news, announcements, and meeting requests.
